summary: Two issues need attention at East Bus Substation: corrosion on the third east-bus insulator requires prompt repair, and transformer T4 shows low oil to check at the next visit. Remaining tracked assets show no reported defects.

defects.title: Corrosion on east bus insulator #3
defects.description: Visible corrosion near the cap of the third insulator on the east bus, observed across frames 360-540.
defects.voiceNoteExcerpt: The third insulator on the east bus has visible corrosion near the cap
defects.recommendedAction: Schedule replacement of insulator-003 within 30 days; treat as arc-flash risk until remediated.

defects.title: Low oil level on transformer T4
defects.description: Inspector reports low oil level on transformer T4; no visual leak confirmed in tracked frames.
defects.voiceNoteExcerpt: Transformer T4 oil level looks low, marking for follow-up next visit
defects.recommendedAction: Verify oil level with gauge at next scheduled maintenance; top up if below threshold.
